landing.eyebrow: For teams without a procurement department
landing.lead: Paste a quote. In two minutes you get a score, the red flags, and a savings number. Go one step further and TermLift builds the full negotiation strategy, writes the email — or runs the whole negotiation for you.

shot.sub: Good base terms, €7,800/yr on the table

how.title: Four steps. Stop at any of them.
how.lead: Every deal in TermLift moves along the same ladder — you'll see it on your deal page exactly like this.
how.s1body: Score out of 100, red flags, a savings range and where the leverage is. Two minutes, no account.
how.s2body: The complete playbook: what to push for, what you can offer, fallback positions, must-have vs nice-to-have savings.
how.s3body: A ready-to-send email in the tone that fits the relationship. Upload the vendor's reply and get round 2.
how.s4body: Hand the deal over. A negotiator runs the back-and-forth, you approve the outcome. No savings, no fee.

who.title: You got the quote. You're not a procurement team.
who.lead: Founders, ops leads, office managers, first-time buyers. TermLift gives you what an enterprise buyer has by default: a number to push for, the words to say, and someone to do it for you if you'd rather not.
who.p1: SaaS, logistics, services, IT — any quote with a total on it

tour.t1body: The quick analysis tells you where you stand. Full Analysis turns that into an ordered list of asks with amounts, fallbacks, and what you can offer in return.
tour.t1b1: Push for, in order, with € impact
tour.t2body: Built from the playbook, matched to the relationship — warm, direct or firm. Upload the vendor's reply and TermLift re-analyses what changed.
tour.t2b1: Tone recommended from the deal type
tour.t2b2: Edit, copy, open in your mail client
tour.t3title: Or hand it to a negotiator

neg.title: Don't want to send the emails? We'll run it.
neg.lead: Hand us the deal and a negotiator takes it from there. You stay in control — nothing is agreed without your sign-off — and you can follow every status change from your dashboard.
neg.p2: The fee is on the documented gap between the quote and the signed deal.
neg.p3: Every request has a status you can see.

pricingPage.foot: {n} free quick analyses per account. Files are deleted after extraction.
pricingPage.faq1q: Does the quick analysis need a credit card?
pricingPage.faq1a: No. Analyse your first quote free, with no card and no signup.
pricingPage.faq2a: The complete negotiation strategy for one specific deal: the ordered list of asks with amounts, fallback positions, what you can offer in return, and the ready-to-send email. It also unlocks follow-up rounds on that deal.
pricingPage.faq3q: How much does Full Analysis cost?
pricingPage.faq3a: We haven't finalised the price yet. Until we do, Full Analysis is included once you've started an analysis — we'll be upfront here before that changes.
pricingPage.faq4a: A follow-up analysis on the same deal. After Full Analysis, upload the vendor's counter-offer and TermLift re-analyses the updated terms — what changed, and how your strategy should adjust. Rounds belong to the deal, not to a subscription.
pricingPage.faq5q: How does the TermLift Negotiate fee work?
pricingPage.faq5a: It's success-based: {pct}% of the verified savings once the deal closes — nothing if we don't save you money. Verified means the documented difference between the original quote and the final signed terms.
